title: Mar Zutra Rabbah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 50a and Beitzah 8a: “Mar Zutra expounded in the name of Mar Zutra Rabbah.” Hyman considers it very likely that what we find in Menachot 35b — “Rav Ashi was sitting before Mar Zutra; his tefillin strap turned over. (Rav Ashi) said to him, ‘Does the Master not hold that their beauty is outward?’ He said, ‘It did not occur to me’” — is Mar Zutra Rabbah. Hyman suggests that possibly this Mar Zutra is the one who spoke in Rav Huna’s name in Eruvin 41b.

notes.text: Saved Davidson Eruvin 41b fully names Rav Huna. Hyman’s very-likely identification and further possible identification remain separate conjectures; no identity merge is performed.
